title.value: SMAFace: Sample Mining Guided Adaptive Loss for Face Recognition

TLDR.value: We propose an innovative FR algorithm that enhances performance by incorporating sample mining into conventional margin-based methods.

abstract.value: Traditional face recognition (FR) algorithms often rely merely on margin-based softmax loss functions. However, due to noisy training data and varied image quality in datasets, these models often falter when dealing with low-quality images. To address this issue, we introduce SMAFace, an innovative FR algorithm that enhances performance by incorporating sample mining into conventional margin-based methods. At its core, SMAFace focuses on prioritizing information-dense samples, namely hard samples or easy samples, which present more distinctive features. In this study, we employ a probability-driven mining strategy, enabling the model to adeptly navigate hard samples, thereby bolstering its robustness and adaptability. The mathematical evaluation and empirical tests of SMAFace indicate its effectiveness. Moreover, experimental results reveal that our approach surpasses the state-of-the-art (SoTA) on four renowned datasets (CPLFW, VGG2-FP, IJB-B and TinyFace), highlighting its potential and efficiency.
